remedies.title: Replace semaphore 'buf_lock' (used as a lock) with a priority-inheriting mutex
remedies.rationale: A POSIX semaphore has no owner, so the QNX kernel cannot raise the priority of the thread that holds it: a medium-priority thread preempts the holder and the high-priority waiter waits for both. A pthread mutex has an owner; with PTHREAD_PRIO_INHERIT (the QNX default) the holder runs at the waiter's priority until it unlocks.

remedies.title: Deadline misses in 'control': a symptom
remedies.rationale: deadline miss is the visible effect; the trace also shows its cause (priority_inversion). It is expected to clear with that fix, and the re-trace checks that it does.

remedies.title: Shrink the 'buf_lock' critical section: move tl_spin_us outside the lock
remedies.rationale: Every MUTEX wait in a QNX trace is real contention (uncontended mutexes never enter the kernel). The lock only needs to cover statements that read or write the data it protects; computation on private buffers inside it serialises the threads for nothing.
